aiLearning.title: Learning engine
aiLearning.sub: Tirondaj and Doot's own continuous-learning loop: research a source → check it against the quality gate → either a new skill in the basket, or recorded as “doesn't work for us”. Plus their practice tasks and paid-tool proposals.
aiLearning.needPermission: You can see this page, but only “AI control” can change anything on it.

card.d: Off by default. Curating a learning source still works while this is off; everything else below refuses.
card.onHelp: Research, the quality-gate check, promoting a verified tip into the skill basket, practice tasks and paid-tool proposals all need this on.
card.minIndependentSourcesHelp: When a tip has no official-docs source, this many distinct sources must back it before the quality gate lets it be tested.

err.STALE: Someone else saved this first — refreshed with the latest.
err.BUSY: Someone else saved this first — refreshed with the latest.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
err.network: Could not reach the server. Try again.

sources.d: Where each power agent reads from — official docs, practitioner blogs, Reddit, YouTube transcripts, specialists on LinkedIn/Facebook, case studies.
sources.empty: No source yet — add one below.

tips.h: Tips — research, the quality gate, the basket
tips.d: A new tip starts as a candidate. Checking it either verifies it (official docs, or enough independent sources, plus a real test note) or fails it — recorded honestly as “doesn't work for us”, never thrown away.
tips.empty: No tip yet — propose one below.

verify.testNote: What was tried, and what happened (sandbox or a small live test)
verify.failedGate: Did not pass the quality gate — recorded as “doesn't work for us”.

promote.name: Skill name
promote.promoted: Sent to the skill basket — waiting for approval.

practice.d: A task with a deadline (e.g. “get a new page indexed within 3 days”, “a long-tail keyword into the top 10”, “a test campaign under the CPA cap”) — graded here, read into the agent's own appraisal.
practice.empty: No practice task yet — add one below.

paidTool.d: An SEO suite, an ads intelligence tool and the like — proposed here with its cost and the reason; it waits in AI › Approvals for the owner to approve and pay. Nothing here ever charges anything by itself.
